expectation: Feedback uses only helpful and not_helpful synthetic labels.
A customer can rate a public AI answer, including safe refusal.
A customer can rate a public human Operator reply.
Customer, system, handoff-pending, missing, and cross-session messages are rejected.
A message has one immutable feedback record.
Same key replays and a new key on the same value returns already_recorded.
Different values and reused keys are rejected without overwriting the first record.
Create, replay, and conflict outcomes are audited with fixed identifiers only.
Public message history restores feedback state.
Feedback does not invoke AI, retrieval, handoff, or external writes.
Labels are local evaluation signals, not a formal satisfaction policy.
